info.name: E-Commerce - Search Service
info.description: Run with the Collection Runner (the 'Wait for ...' requests retry while Kafka events travel). Needs discovery-server, config-server and all services. Republishes the catalog (so older products are searchable), creates 4 products in a small category tree, then searches: prefixes, brands, categories, filters with counts, sorting, typo correction; changes stock, a rating, a category name and discontinues a product, and waits for search to follow each change.

item.name: Wait for search-service to index the 4 products (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.results.totalElements === 4; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('search-service indexed the products', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('Pixel 9 and Pixel Buds', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.results.content.map(p => p.name).every(n => n.startsWith('Pixel'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Start of a word is enough: pix
Price after discount on the result
Filter: Electronics includes its sub-category Phones

exec: pm.test('Pixel Buds only', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.results.content.map(p => p.name.replace(' ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runTag'), ''))).to.eql(["Pixel Buds"]));

item.name: Facets: counts per brand, category, price

exec: pm.test('Brands ignore the brand filter (still offers Samsung, Anker)', () => pm.expect(f.brands.map(b => `${b.value}=${b.count}`)).to.eql(['Google=2', 'Anker=1', 'Samsung=1']));
pm.test('Other facets count Google only', () => pm.expect(f.categories.map(c => c.count).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)).to.eql(2));

pm.test('Cable, Buds, Galaxy, Pixel 9', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.results.content.map(p => p.name.replace(' ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runTag'), ''))).to.eql(["USB-C Cable", "Pixel Buds", "Pixel 9", "Galaxy S24"]));
